sloka: न धर्मवादे न च लोकवृत्ते न शास्त्रबुद्धिग्रहणेषु चापि ।विद्येत कश्चित्तव वीरतुल्यस्त्वं ह्युत्तमः सर्वसुरासुराणाम् ।। ५.५२.१७।।।।
transliteration: na dharmavāde na ca lokavṛtte na śāstrabuddhigrahaṇeṣu cāpi ।vidyeta kaścittava vīratulyastvaṁ hyuttamaḥ sarvasurāsurāṇām ।। 5.52.17।।।।

translations.english: "Heroic Ravana there is hardly any one who is equal to you in the knowledge of dharma, in the practice of worldly affairs and in grasping subtle truths of sastras. Indeed you are supreme among suras and asuras.
